preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 15 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 15 inclusive.
The number of distinct positive numbers K is between 1 and 7 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= board[i][j] <= n*m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each entry in the board is between -1 and n*m inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cost[i][j] <= 100000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each entry in the cost matrix is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (any(len(set([board[i][j] for i, j in block])) >= K for block in connected_blocks if all(board[i][j] != -1 for i, j in block)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, there exists a connected block with at least K distinct positive numbers and no -1, and the output is the minimum cost of selecting such a block.
